Importantly, we are also seeing the benefits of the investment made over the previous years in customer acquisition, product visibility, technology, and operational capabilities.
Growth & demand: EBITDA stood at INR6.47 crore s, representing a growth of 32.9%.
From the December to March quarter, you had more than 90% growth quarter -on-quarter.
I can see 20% to 25% growth, but as customer confidence grows, it could be around 50%.
Margins & costs: Our PAT margin improved to 11.5%, reflecting better earnings conversion and operating leverage.
I wanted to know the reason behind this because if we see the last seven or eight half - yearly results, there is extreme volatility in our EBITDA margin 8%, 15%, then 11%, 21%, 14%, 22%.
Imagine a company that started with INR30 lakhs EBITDA.
Capex & expansion: Because say the commissions were 10% earlier, but and say advertising was say 2%, 3%.
So now the commissions are zero, but with say the advertising spend is just 5%, then there is a 6%, 7% saving.
Our products already had good rankings, and as soon as there was 0% commission, we could afford more spending compared to other brands.
Balance sheet & cash: These are all brands that will give me leverage in terms of profits.

Risks & challenges: We believe this initiative can address important challenge in online fashion and lifestyle shopping by providing customer greater confidence before completing the purchase.
For our in-house brands, honestly, this has been very favorable for us because it has brought us right to the top in the competition.
It's been quite volatile, so investors are not confident on their estimates because the margin is not yet stabilized anywhere.
